scenario: A technician must explain a DDoS attack to non-technical staff.
question: Draw a diagram showing how a DDoS attack works using a botnet to overwhelm a target server by traffic from many compromised devices.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Attacker([Attacker]) --> C2[Command & Control Server] --> Device1[Compromised Device]

  C2 --> Device3[Compromised Device]

  Device2 --> Target
  Device3 --> Target
  Target --> Down[Server Overwhelmed / Offline]
